page_title: NOT 0-1 SUN | Nottingham Forest v Sunderland 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Hjelde L. F. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland) produced a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Matz Sels thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.

90+3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Morato (Nottingham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Sunderland is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arnaud Kalimuendo (Nottingham) replaces Chris Wood.
89' The ball is out of play. Sunderland win a corner kick.
88' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
87' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) heads on.
85' Regis Le Bris prepares a substitution. Chemsdine Talbi is replaced by Simon Adingra (Sunderland).
85' Substitution. Wilson Isidor makes his way off the pitch and Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) comes on as his replacement.
82' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sees a yellow card from Tony Harrington after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
80' Chris Wood (Nottingham) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!

79' Chris Wood (Nottingham) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Robin Roefs.
78' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Nottingham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
77' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) commits a rough foul. Tony Harrington stops the game and makes a call. Nottingham have a free kick.
75' Substitution. Enzo Le Fee is replaced by Daniel Ballard (Sunderland).

74' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Robin Roefs dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Igor Jesus (Nottingham).

73' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the bottom right corner, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
73' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
72' Substitution. Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) in, Dilane Bakwa out.

69' That didn't go as planned. Bertrand Traore (Sunderland) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Matz Sels, who easily kept it out.
68' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) tested Robin Roefs with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.

67' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
67' Nottingham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
66' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

65' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Robin Roefs pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill. Nottingham earn a corner.
64' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) launches a cross from the corner, but Robin Roefs is alert to thwart the effort.

64' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' The game is interrupted now, Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dan Ndoye leaves the pitch and Igor Jesus (Nottingham) comes on.
60' A substitution has been made. James McAtee is replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
59' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Arthur Masuaku and he is replaced by Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland).
59' It will be a substitution. Bertrand Traore (Sunderland) is ready to enter the pitch as Christopher Rigg walks off.
58' James McAtee (Nottingham) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
57' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
56' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Trai Hume (Sunderland). Tony Harrington saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
51' A corner kick by Sunderland is thwarted by the well prepared Matz Sels (Nottingham).
50' Arthur Masuaku (Sunderland) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Sunderland.
49' Neco Williams (Nottingham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
48' Nottingham fail to score from a corner as Robin Roefs (Sunderland) leaps to collect the ball.
47' Neco Williams (Nottingham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Nottingham will take a corner kick.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolas Dominguez can be given a rest.
46' Referee Tony Harrington blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' None of the Nottingham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

45+2' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. Nottingham force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
40' Tony Harrington sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
39' The Sunderland players halt their celebrations as referee Tony Harrington makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
38' The main referee, Tony Harrington, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) is given a yellow card for dissent.

38' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Omar Alderete (Sunderland) rises high inside the six-yard box to meet a cross by Granit Xhaka from the free kick. He heads home into the middle of the goal, making the score 0:1.
36' Today's referee Tony Harrington rightly decides to book Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) for his harsh tackle.
36' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
33' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
31' Arthur Masuaku (Sunderland) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
30' The free kick is taken by Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland), but ball is cleared.
29' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) attempts to find Chemsdine Talbi, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
28' The foul by Neco Williams (Nottingham) was seen by Tony Harrington who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
25' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
24' Good clearance! Chris Wood (Nottingham) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.

23' Chris Wood (Nottingham) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
22' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

22' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.

17' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
16' A lofted cross from Chris Wood (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
14' An attempted cross from James McAtee (Nottingham) is cleared.
9' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) for a tough tackle.
9' A rebound falls to Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post.
7' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
6' A player from Sunderland takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
4' Arthur Masuaku (Sunderland) brings his opponent down. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Arthur Masuaku (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
2' A quickly taken corner by Sunderland.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Sunderland will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tony Harrington.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
